ctx.x: It's a dark night. He said, I really would like to turn it into another show, you know, because they're trying to -- they're threatening me with some kind of lawsuit. And he said, I'm going to reverse the charges (unintelligible). "Dames at Sea," you see, because they wrote -- they write story -- they were story writers.
